reason: A collaborative commemorative photo wall that authenticates eligible GitHub users, accepts member messages, displays shared polaroid-style entries, and can export a static archive.

summaries.zh: 一个面向限定成员的协作合影墙，支持 GitHub 登录、留言入镜、实时展示成员卡片并导出静态纪念版。
summaries.en: A collaborative group photo wall for eligible members that supports GitHub sign-in, message submissions, live member-card display, and static archive export.

capabilities: Authenticated viewing and submission of group photo entries
Storage and display of member messages, avatars, timestamps, and repository mappings
Optional GitHub organization member retrieval using a personal access token
